title: Oru Bilathi Pranayam
overview: Oru Bilathi Pranayam is a Malayalam movie directed by Canatious Athipozhiyil and produced by Garshom Media. Letesia Kuncheria, Kuriakose, Lawrence Larckin are doing the lead roles in this film. Music has been composed by Canatious Athipozhiyil and the screenplay was by Jinson Iritty
